deployment_conditioning.serving_default_differs: The deployed serving default is wr_id 33 (~0.66 win rate) / games_id 6 (1000 games). This forecast is sealed at the expert-slice pair wr_id 28 (>= 0.55) / games_id 4 (>= 100 games), so it is NOT identical to what the live assistant returns under its defaults.

forecast_definition.letter: PRESENTATION ONLY. Fixed percentile bands on a 13-level ladder, assigned by rank, never by score threshold.
forecast_definition.rounding_rule: largest-remainder (Hamilton) apportionment of the 193 cards over the 13 bands: floor each ideal share, then award leftover slots to the largest fractional remainders, ties broken toward the better grade. Counts sum to 193 exactly.
forecast_definition.score: raw model logit for the card at P1P1 over the full set list

provenance.hob_data_used: public Scryfall card records ONLY (name, type line, mana cost, oracle text, rarity, keywords). No HOB draft picks, outcomes, ratings, or community grades of any kind exist in this pipeline.
